observation: Tapping 'Lock the bylaws & form the squads' shows a 1.5 s toast 'Lock failed. Something went wrong — please try again.' observation: Six of six web testers posted a round 7 days before first tee (Sep 5). The form preview said 'LEAGUE POINTS THIS ROUND 5' (or 6, or 12 — 'You torched your number by 5.0'). Standings then showed 'R 0 · Pts 0'; the player's own row sheet said 'No rounds this season yet — post one and you're on the board.'; You said 'THIS SEASON · Rounds posted 0' beside 'LIFETIME · Rounds posted 1'. The only pre-season hint on the form was 'No league yet?' (wrong — they were members). Home simultaneously said 'SEASON LIVE — Rounds count from today' (A3) while the Clubhouse said 'PRACTICE ROUNDS HIT YOUR CARD, NOT THE SEASON'; the feed showed league mates' rounds while every standings row was 0; 'COUNTING ROUNDS 0 / 4 · August' counted a month before the season.

screen: How scoring works sheet / post-form point bands / receipt
observation: 'Torched it · beat it by 3+ · 12' never says 3 of WHAT; the receipt reveals index − differential (slope-adjusted), not strokes vs course handicap (~18% different at slope 133).
